clockNote: at is seconds from scenario start

scenarios.name: no_connect_req_while_a_session_is_believed_alive
scenarios.note: §4.4: a client must never connect_req over its own live session

scenarios.name: losing_signaling_does_not_tear_down_media
scenarios.note: the control plane dying must not interrupt an established media path

scenarios.name: resume_is_sent_even_when_hello_ok_has_no_active_session_id
scenarios.note: our own session record is enough; the server advertisement is a bonus

scenarios.name: a_failed_resume_frees_the_slot_and_tick_retries
scenarios.note: a transient error keeps the session and retries; only no_session/bad_token discard it

scenarios.name: renew_fires_on_schedule_and_not_before
scenarios.note: granted at t=0 with a 300s renew interval

scenarios.name: server_restart_with_a_remembered_code_reconnects_silently
scenarios.note: every session died with the server; prompting the user would be wrong

scenarios.name: a_host_never_silently_reconnects
scenarios.note: a host holds no access code to offer

scenarios.name: an_up_to_up_ice_change_does_not_spam_input_reset
scenarios.note: connected -> completed is not a gap; resetting would drop held keys mid-drag

scenarios.name: a_session_we_own_but_cannot_resume_is_discarded_not_surfaced_as_busy
scenarios.note: app restarted, token died with the process, server still advertises the session

scenarios.name: busy_against_our_own_session_clears_it_and_retries_exactly_once
scenarios.note: the second busy is a genuine second controller and must surface

scenarios.name: the_busy_retry_guard_survives_a_signaling_flap
scenarios.note: reconnecting re-advertises the stale session; without the one-shot guard connectFailed(busy) would bye-and-retry forever against a genuine second controller

scenarios.name: a_resumable_session_is_never_discarded
scenarios.note: holding a token means resume, never bye

scenarios.name: a_deliberately_closed_session_is_not_resurrected
scenarios.note: the regression the first stale-session fix caused: closed is closed
